evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet most evaluations still focus on whether generated code passes benchmark test suites.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Functional correctness alone, however, provides only a limited view of quality: benchmark tests are often incomplete, and passing them does not guarantee that code is maintainable, reliable, or well-structured.
